availableCommands.name: google-workspace
availableCommands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files.

# Review candidate

Read-only. Do not repair or start another review.

## Specification
### P07.4 — Access без AzGuard и мост access-azguard

**Intent:** Сделать `corex-access` самостоятельным: права вычисляются собственной матрицей ролей и прямыми grants, компиляция матрицы публикует событие, а вся интеграция с AzGuard уходит в новый пакет-мост `axiomasoft/corex-access-azguard`, исключённый из релизного набора до публикации AzGuard.

**Why:** D14, D96 B (п.6–п.7); AzGuard не опубликован (W7), а access тянет его через package-репозиторий на приватный VCS, что D16 запрещает релизному пакету; `research/04-architecture.md` §9 называет мост.

**Scope Included:** `DefaultAccessChecker::allowed()` по examples §9; `DirectGrantLookup` на `aut_direct_grants`; миграция `aut_direct_grants`; `DatabaseRoleMatrixCompiler` без AzGuard + событие `CoreX\Access\Matrix\Events\RoleMatrixCompiled` (Api); `PrincipalIdentity` без AzGuard-контрактов; registrars, config и `AuthOptions` access без AzGuard; миграция `aut_roles` без `azguard_role_id`; новый пакет `packages/access-azguard` (composer, provider, registrar, перенос пяти AzGuard-классов, слушатель `SyncAzGuardRolePermissions`, миграция `aut_azguard_role_links`, config pins, Blade-директивы, тесты, README/PACKAGE/CHANGELOG); `scripts/manifest-check.py` `UNRELEASED`; `scripts/ownership-map.json`, glossary §Packages, `docs/architecture/table-ownership.md`; CI-шаги и `test:packages` для моста; тесты `NativePermissionTest`, `AzGuardBridgeTest`; Golden delta P07.4.

**Scope Excluded:** публикация AzGuard и включение моста в релиз (owner-gate Q2, P09); перенос данных из `az_guard_direct_grants` (ничего не опубликовано, D01); изменение scope-предикатов (guards активности в scopeFor/canOnRecord/query apply включены по D98); baseline схемы (P08).

**Inputs:** `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D100-p07-grok-design-remediation.md` · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D98-p07-design-audit-remediation.md` · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D96-p07-impersonation-access-edges.md` (B) · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D14-access-azguard.md` · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/research/P07-design.md` (§1.4, §2, §3.4, §4, §5) · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/research/P07-design-rag.md` (W7) · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07-design/examples.md` (§9–§11) · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07-design/facts/azguard-coupling.txt` · результат P07.3 (`plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07.3-execution/completion.md`, появляется после его исполнения)

**Files:** `scripts/package-graph-gate.php` (VALID_STABILITY), `docs/architecture/taxonomy.md` (§Stability); `packages/access/CHANGELOG.md`; `packages/access/src/Access/Internal/{DefaultAccessChecker,DefaultScopeResolver,DirectGrantLookup}.php`; `packages/access/src/Matrix/Internal/DatabaseRoleMatrixCompiler.php`; `packages/access/src/Roles/Internal/Models/Role.php`; `packages/access/src/Roles/Data/RoleView.php`; `packages/access/src/Roles/Laravel/RoleMatrixData.php`; `packages/access/src/Matrix/Events/RoleMatrixCompiled.php` (новый); `packages/access/src/Access/Laravel/PrincipalIdentity.php`; `packages/access/src/Laravel/{AccessBindingsRegistrar,AccessIntegrationRegistrar}.php`; `packages/access/src/{Access/Internal/AutMatrixGrantSource,Access/Internal/WorkspacePermissionLayer,Matrix/Internal/MatrixPermissionCatalogBuilder,Matrix/Laravel/AzGuardRoleModel,Tenancy/Internal/TenantContextGuard}.php` (перенос в мост); AuthOptions и `packages/access/config/corex-access.php`; `packages/access/database/migrations/tenant/2026_07_26_200001_create_aut_roles_table.php`, `packages/access/database/migrations/tenant/2026_10_04_000001_create_aut_direct_grants_table.php` (новая); `packages/access/composer.json`, `packages/access/{README,PACKAGE}.md`, `packages/access/phpstan-baseline.neon`; `packages/access/tests/**` (AzGuard-тесты → мост; `NativePermissionTest` новый); `packages/access-azguard/**` (новый пакет); `composer.json` (root: require-dev моста, `test:packages`), `composer.lock` (только path-пакет моста); `scripts/manifest-check.py`, `scripts/ownership-map.json`; `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/research/03-glossary.md`; `docs/architecture/table-ownership.md`; `.github/workflows/ci.yml`; `packages/{access,access-azguard}/resources/contracts/php-api.json`; `tests/Golden/baseline/*` (строки P07.4 из §4); `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07.4-execution/**`.

**Required Reads:** 1) `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/research/P07-design.md` §1.4, §3.4; 2) `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07-design/examples.md` §9–§11; 3) `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D96-p07-impersonation-access-edges.md`; 4) `packages/access/src/Access/Internal/DefaultAccessChecker.php`; 5) `packages/access/src/Matrix/Internal/DatabaseRoleMatrixCompiler.php`; `packages/access/src/Roles/Internal/Models/Role.php`; `packages/access/src/Roles/Data/RoleView.php`; `packages/access/src/Roles/Laravel/RoleMatrixData.php`; 6) `packages/access/src/Laravel/AccessBindingsRegistrar.php`; 7) `packages/access/composer.json`; 8) `scripts/manifest-check.py`.

**Implementation Rules:** D98 п.8–9: EntityActivity guards before any grant/memo; bridge owns role links, public RoleMatrixData/EntityActivity only; no foreign Internal. RoleView/RoleMatrixData public delta in Golden/changelog. В `packages/access` после item нет ни одной ссылки на AzGuard, кроме CHANGELOG. Оценка fail-closed: неизвестная сущность, отсутствующая роль, scope `none`, чужой workspace, истёкший или отозванный grant → false. Перенос классов в мост — `git mv` с правкой namespace; поведение AzGuard-интеграции сохраняется (sync `az_guard_role_permissions` в одной транзакции). D100: закрытый набор graph/taxonomy/manifest получает пятое значение `unreleased`; `stability: unreleased` допустим только для имён из `UNRELEASED`. Без алиасов (D01). Manifest и changelog каждого затронутого пакета — в одном продуктовом commit; base SHA — до правок.

**Code Guidance:** Досье §3.4 шаги 1–7; examples §9 (allowed и worked example), §10 (миграция и table-ownership), §11 (composer моста, manifest-check и негатив, слушатель синхронизации).

**Validation:**
- После продуктового commit: `bash scripts/contract-guard.sh` и `bash scripts/contract-guard.sh "$(cat plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07.4-execution/base-commit.txt)"` → exit 0.
- `git grep -n -i -E 'azguard|az_guard' -- packages/access ':!packages/access/CHANGELOG.md'` → пусто.
- `scripts/php84 composer --working-dir=packages/access test` и `PGSQL_PORT=5434 scripts/php84 composer --working-dir=packages/access test:pg` → exit 0, включая `NativePermissionTest` (examples §9: stale matrix/direct grant на unknown/inactive entity отказывает во всех четырёх paths) без установленного AzGuard в closure access.
- `scripts/php84 composer --working-dir=packages/access-azguard test` → exit 0 (`AzGuardBridgeTest`: после `RoleMatrixCompiled` `az_guard_role_permissions` совпадает с матрицей; связь в `aut_azguard_role_links`, чистая схема без aut_roles.azguard_role_id, rollback listener, отсутствие foreign Internal).
- `scripts/php84 composer package-graph-gate`, `scripts/php84 composer manifests:check`, `scripts/php84 composer ownership-gate`, `scripts/php84 composer table-ownership-gate`, `scripts/php84 composer naming-gate` → exit 0; негативы examples §11: mystery отклоняют оба gate, foreign unreleased отклоняет manifest-check; bridge unreleased проходит graph; вернуть.
- `scripts/php84 composer test:packages`, `PGSQL_PORT=5434 scripts/php84 composer test:pg` → exit 0.
- `scripts/php84 php scripts/php-api.php --write` дважды → идентично; `scripts/php84 composer php-api`, `scripts/php84 composer bc-check` → exit 0; diff Golden — только строки P07.4 из досье §4.
- `scripts/php84 composer lint:check`, `scripts/php84 composer analyse`, `scripts/php84 composer deps:analyse` → exit 0; `bash scripts/anti-weakening-gate.sh` → exit 0; `php scripts/package-docs-gate.php` → exit 0.
- Review `light` (D97): self-check по досье §6; строка `review: self-check GREEN` в Completion Notes.

**Deliverables:** package changelogs; `artifacts/P07.4-execution/base-commit.txt` и candidate SHA; access без AzGuard; `aut_direct_grants`; `RoleMatrixCompiled`; пакет `access-azguard` со своими тестами; manifest-check `UNRELEASED`; обновлённые ownership-map, glossary, table-ownership, CI; Golden delta P07.4; `artifacts/P07.4-execution/completion.md`.

# Review candidate

Read-only. Do not repair or start another review.

## Specification
### P07.4 — Access без AzGuard и мост access-azguard

**Intent:** Сделать `corex-access` самостоятельным: права вычисляются собственной матрицей ролей и прямыми grants, компиляция матрицы публикует событие, а вся интеграция с AzGuard уходит в новый пакет-мост `axiomasoft/corex-access-azguard`, исключённый из релизного набора до публикации AzGuard.

**Why:** D14, D96 B (п.6–п.7); AzGuard не опубликован (W7), а access тянет его через package-репозиторий на приватный VCS, что D16 запрещает релизному пакету; `research/04-architecture.md` §9 называет мост.

**Scope Included:** `DefaultAccessChecker::allowed()` по examples §9; `DirectGrantLookup` на `aut_direct_grants`; миграция `aut_direct_grants`; `DatabaseRoleMatrixCompiler` без AzGuard + событие `CoreX\Access\Matrix\Events\RoleMatrixCompiled` (Api); `PrincipalIdentity` без AzGuard-контрактов; registrars, config и `AuthOptions` access без AzGuard; миграция `aut_roles` без `azguard_role_id`; новый пакет `packages/access-azguard` (composer, provider, registrar, перенос пяти AzGuard-классов, слушатель `SyncAzGuardRolePermissions`, миграция `aut_azguard_role_links`, config pins, Blade-директивы, тесты, README/PACKAGE/CHANGELOG); `scripts/manifest-check.py` `UNRELEASED`; `scripts/ownership-map.json`, glossary §Packages, `docs/architecture/table-ownership.md`; CI-шаги и `test:packages` для моста; тесты `NativePermissionTest`, `AzGuardBridgeTest`; Golden delta P07.4.

**Scope Excluded:** публикация AzGuard и включение моста в релиз (owner-gate Q2, P09); перенос данных из `az_guard_direct_grants` (ничего не опубликовано, D01); изменение scope-предикатов (guards активности в scopeFor/canOnRecord/query apply включены по D98); baseline схемы (P08).

Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files.

1→# P07.4 completion

## Candidate

Product commit: `9e56afe69ef2525f7ec3a68ca3b252e6b9bf1078`. Base: `9fe70584928a409b9a6377655ceaa71e4e575cc2`. Product and closure evidence use separate commits because postcommit guards, review inventory and terminal projections must bind the completed product. The initial unpublished product candidate is retained as a binary patch in `artifacts/P07.4/first-candidate-product.patch`; its distinct validation logs remain available.

## Product

Access now evaluates native role matrices and `aut_direct_grants`, with entity activity guards before grants/memo on all four paths. Compilation dispatches `RoleMatrixCompiled` synchronously inside the tenant transaction and invalidates scope versions after commit. The unreleased `access-azguard` integration owns links, pins, mirroring, Blade directives and the five moved implementation classes. Its registered listener rollback and captured-tenant behavior have runtime tests.
10→
Metadata, CI/package aggregation, docs, migrations and public API/Golden artifacts reflect this boundary. Exactly 19 unique public BC changes are bound to the accepted base and D96/D98/D100. Supporting paths beyond the narrow Files list are generated public API/configuration docs, exact BC approvals, configuration registry ownership transfer, Golden harness/REBASELINE and comment-only removal of obsolete access coupling references. They are included in the independent review inventory.

## Validation

`composite-validation-9e56afe6-r1.json` selects actual GREEN results for all 29 final checks from canonical immutable receipts with identical candidate digest `0981013bf7583b33266b22b601bb1f7cd11cf7f39ff4469d5c7098eb4bae7da7`. The first final attempt stopped only at Composer platform resolution for tenancy: native PHP 8.4 lacked its pre-existing dev requirement `ext-redis`. A configured-APT Redis/igbinary package was extracted locally and loaded only for the dependency checker; its version, hashes and actual runtime are logged in the second receipt. No source, system configuration, platform requirement or gate was bypassed. Previously GREEN checks retain their original environments and receipts; the failed carrier and remaining carriers were rerun separately.

Mandatory full package and PostgreSQL suites, API byte idempotence, BC, Golden, lint, PHPStan, dependency analysis, anti-weakening and package docs are GREEN. Both post-product contract guards are GREEN. Mutation `--all` passed all 37 cases. `negative-final-9e56afe6-r1/negative-summary.json` proves mystery rejection in graph/manifest, foreign unreleased rejection, bridge unreleased acceptance and exact restoration.

review: self-check GREEN
20→
Fresh final-candidate independent static self-check: `self-check.md`. Selected owner reviewer: `grok/grok-4.7/500000`, high effort, fresh read-only native session. The canonical receipt under `artifacts/P07.4/owner-review/` is the authority for its verdict; these notes do not predeclare that verdict.

## Scope and delivery

No unresolved current product finding remains before independent owner review. Unrelated owner worktree changes are preserved. The existing tasks-workflow → wakeup exception belongs to P07.5. At the owner's explicit request, P07.5 will start in a new session after P07.4 is closed.

38→### B. Access без AzGuard (P07.4)

40→6. `corex-access` не зависит от AzGuard (D14): `AccessChecker::allowed()` вычисляется собственными данными — активное назначение роли принципала в текущем workspace с ненулевым scope в `aut_role_matrix` для `(entity, action)` **или** активный прямой grant в новой tenant-таблице `aut_direct_grants` (`id uuid`, `principal_type`, `principal_id uuid`, `permission_key`, `expires_at nullable`, `revoked_at nullable`, timestamps; индекс по `(principal_type, principal_id, permission_key)`). `RoleMatrixCompiler::compile()` валидирует матрицу и повышает `ScopeMapVersion`, затем диспатчит `RoleMatrixCompiled(roleId)`. `PrincipalIdentity` не реализует AzGuard-контракты. Колонка `aut_roles.azguard_role_id` удаляется из миграции access (D01, правка на месте; baseline — P08).
7. **Мост** `packages/access-azguard` — `axiomasoft/corex-access-azguard`, `CoreX\AccessAzguard\`, тип `bridge`; требует `axiomasoft/corex-access` и `axioma-studio/azguard-core ^0.3`. Переносит в мост: `TenantContextGuard` (AzGuard `ContextGuard`), `WorkspacePermissionLayer`, `AutMatrixGrantSource`, `MatrixPermissionCatalogBuilder`, `AzGuardRoleModel`, синхронизацию `az_guard_role_permissions` по `RoleMatrixCompiled`, связь ролей в таблице моста `aut_azguard_role_links (role_id uuid pk, azguard_role_id bigint)`, AzGuard config pins и Blade-директивы. `extra.corex.stability = "unreleased"`: `scripts/manifest-check.py` принимает это значение только для закрытого списка `UNRELEASED = {"axiomasoft/corex-access-azguard"}`; релизный набор P09 его исключает до публикации стабильного AzGuard (owner-gate Q2). Строка в glossary §Packages.

### C. Рёбра модулей (P07.5)

8. Новый модуль ядра `CoreX\Scheduling` (glossary §Kernel modules) публикует контракты отложенного пробуждения: `Contracts\{WakeupScheduler, DueWakeupSource, DueWakeupHandler}`, `Data\{WakeupRequest, WakeupWindow, WakeupDelivery, WakeupHandlerDefinition, ScheduleResult, CancelResult, SweepResult}`. Пакет `corex-wakeup` их реализует и сохраняет свои `DueWakeupSweeper`, `WakeupScheduleHint`. Перенос — без алиасов (D01).
9. Обработчики пакетов регистрируются тегом `WakeupHandlerDefinition::TAG` (`corex.scheduling.wakeup-handlers`) на биндинге, возвращающем `WakeupHandlerDefinition`; источники — тегом `DueWakeupSource::TAG` (`corex.scheduling.due-sources`). `corex-wakeup` объединяет тегированные определения с `corex-wakeup.handlers` хоста; повтор `kind` → `InvalidConfiguration` при boot. Запись чужого config-ключа (`corex-wakeup.handlers` из notifications) запрещена.
10. `corex-notifications` требует только ядро; digest при `digest_enabled = true` и отсутствии биндинга `WakeupScheduler` → `InvalidConfiguration` (RuntimeConfigCheck notifications), а не тихое отключение. `corex-tasks-workflow` теряет `suggest` на wakeup. `tools → operations` и `webhooks → operations` остаются жёсткими рёбрами: оба пакета регистрируют свои операции в движке operations и без него бессмысленны (D16).
11. `scripts/package-graph-gate.php` в целевом графе: ребро `notifications → wakeup` запрещено; негативный контроль — внесённый импорт `CoreX\Wakeup\` в notifications красит гейт.

50→## Why

A: `pplx-03` — just-in-time grant, short TTL, two correlated audit views, fail-closed; D70 п.9 требует обнулить baseline. B: D14 и AzGuard не опубликован (`http-01`, 404). C: D16 и `research/04` §4 («notifications ↛ wakeup, контракт в ядре»); запись чужого config-ключа — скрытое ребро.

## Consequences

P07.3 — A; P07.4 — B; P07.5 — C. Golden/BC: новые порты и enum (Spi/Api), перенос symbols wakeup в `CoreX\Scheduling`, удаление AzGuard-типов из manifest access, новый пакет — reviewed semantic delta (D64). P08 включает `aut_direct_grants` и `aut_azguard_role_links` в baseline и удаляет `root_accounts.data`.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\AccessAzguard\Internal;

use AzGuard\Models\RolePermission;
use CoreX\Access\Enums\Scope;
use CoreX\Access\Laravel\AuthOptions;
use CoreX\Access\Matrix\Contracts\EntityActivity;
use CoreX\Access\Matrix\Events\RoleMatrixCompiled;
use CoreX\Access\Roles\Data\RoleMatrixEntry;
use CoreX\Access\Roles\Laravel\RoleMatrixData;
use Illuminate\Database\Connection;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use LogicException;

/** Mirrors a compiled native matrix into the optional AzGuard storage. */
final readonly class SyncAzGuardRolePermissions
{
    public function __construct(
        private AuthOptions $options,
        private EntityActivity $activeEntities,
        private RoleLinkStore $links,
        private ConnectionResolverInterface $connections,
    ) {}

    public function handle(RoleMatrixCompiled $event): void
    {
        $role = RoleMatrixData::role($event->roleId);
        $matrix = RoleMatrixData::matrix($role->id);
        $panel = $this->options->panel;
        $connection = $this->connections->connection();

        if (! $connection instanceof Connection) {
            throw new LogicException('AzGuard bridge requires a Laravel database connection.');
        }

        $connection->transaction(function () use ($role, $matrix, $panel, $connection): void {
            $azguardRole = (new AzGuardRoleModel)->setConnection($connection->getName())
                ->newQuery()->firstOrCreate(['name' => $role->slug]);

            $this->links->upsert($role->id, $azguardRole->id);

            $permissions = (new RolePermission)->setConnection($connection->getName());
            $permissions->newQuery()->where('role_id', $azguardRole->id)
                ->where('panel_id', $panel)->delete();

            $keys = collect($matrix)
                ->filter(static fn (RoleMatrixEntry $row): bool => $row->scope !== Scope::None)
                ->filter(fn (RoleMatrixEntry $row): bool => $this->activeEntities->isActive($row->entityKey))
                ->map(static fn (RoleMatrixEntry $row): string => "{$panel}.{$row->entityKey}.{$row->action}")
                ->unique();

            foreach ($keys as $key) {
                $permissions->newQuery()->create([
                    'role_id' => $azguardRole->id,
                    'permission_key' => $key,
                    'panel_id' => $panel,
                ]);
            }
        });
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Access\Matrix\Internal;

use CoreX\Access\Contracts\RoleMatrixCompiler;
use CoreX\Access\Matrix\Events\RoleMatrixCompiled;
use CoreX\Access\Roles\Laravel\RoleMatrixData;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Events\Dispatcher;
use Illuminate\Database\Connection;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use LogicException;
use Override;

/** Native matrix compilation; listeners share the transaction and can veto it. */
final readonly class DatabaseRoleMatrixCompiler implements RoleMatrixCompiler
{
    public function __construct(
        private ScopeMapVersion $scopeMapVersion,
        private ConnectionResolverInterface $connections,
        private Dispatcher $events,
    ) {}

    #[Override]
    public function compile(string $roleId): void
    {
        $connection = $this->connections->connection();

        if (! $connection instanceof Connection) {
            throw new LogicException('Matrix compilation requires a transactional Laravel connection.');
        }

        $connection->transaction(function () use ($roleId, $connection): void {
            RoleMatrixData::role($roleId);
            RoleMatrixData::matrix($roleId);

            $this->events->dispatch(new RoleMatrixCompiled($roleId));
            $connection->afterCommit($this->scopeMapVersion->invalidator($roleId));
        });
    }

    #[Override]
    public function recompileAll(): void
    {
        foreach (RoleMatrixData::roleIds() as $roleId) {
            $this->compile($roleId);
        }
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Access\Access\Internal;

use CoreX\Access\Contracts\Principal;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use Illuminate\Database\Query\Builder;
use Psr\Clock\ClockInterface;

/**
 * Whether a principal holds an active native direct grant for one compiled
 * permission key. Extracted out of `DefaultAccessChecker` (D110): both the
 * record path (`canOnRecord()`) and the new builder path
 * (`DefaultScopeResolver::apply()`) treat an active direct grant as a full
 * bypass of the scope predicate, so the query lives once here rather than
 * risking the two copies drifting. Adding a 4th method to the public
 * `AccessChecker` contract for this was rejected (Code Guidance if-then #5)
 * — this lookup is not part of that contract's spec'd shape.
 */
final readonly class DirectGrantLookup
{
    public function __construct(
        private ConnectionResolverInterface $connections,
        private ClockInterface $clock,
    ) {}

    public function hasActive(Principal $p, string $key): bool
    {
        $now = $this->clock->now();

        return $this->connections->connection()->table('aut_direct_grants')
            ->where('principal_type', $p->principalType()->value)
            ->where('principal_id', $p->principalId())
            ->where('permission_key', $key)
            ->whereNull('revoked_at')
            ->where(static function (Builder $q) use ($now): void {
                $q->whereNull('expires_at')->orWhere('expires_at', '>', $now);
            })
            ->exists();
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Access\Access\Internal;

use CoreX\Access\Contracts\AccessChecker;
use CoreX\Access\Contracts\Principal;
use CoreX\Access\Data\RecordContext;
use CoreX\Access\Enums\PrincipalType;
use CoreX\Access\Enums\Scope;
use CoreX\Access\Laravel\AuthOptions;
use CoreX\Access\Matrix\Contracts\EntityActivity;
use CoreX\Access\Matrix\Contracts\ScopeMapVersions as ScopeMapVersion;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\TenancyManager;
use CoreX\Modules\Contracts\EntityRegistry;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use Illuminate\Database\Query\Builder;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Override;
use Psr\Clock\ClockInterface;

/**
 * Two-phase AccessChecker. Permissions come from the native role matrix and
 * direct grants. Fail-closed throughout: an unresolved or inactive entity,
 * absent role row or missing department table never widens to "the whole
 * scope" — it denies.
 *
 * The scope predicate itself (own/dept/dept_tree/workspace/account/none) is
 * NOT decided here (P2.9, D110): it is delegated to {@see ScopePredicate},
 * the single owner shared with the builder path
 * ({@see DefaultScopeResolver}), so the two paths cannot silently diverge.
 * Bound `scoped` (CoreAuthServiceProvider) so the scopeFor() memo below is
 * request-scoped, never carried across requests on a reused worker.
 */
final class DefaultAccessChecker implements AccessChecker
{
    /** @var array<string, Scope> Keyed with every contributing role's ScopeMapVersion — a compile() bump changes the key, i.e. a guaranteed miss. */
    private array $scopeMemo = [];

    public function __construct(
        private readonly EntityRegistry $entities,
        private readonly TenancyManager $tenancyManager,
        private readonly ScopeMapVersion $scopeMapVersion,
        private readonly ScopePredicate $scopePredicate,
        private readonly DirectGrantLookup $directGrants,
        private readonly AuthOptions $options,
        private readonly ConnectionResolverInterface $connections,
        private readonly ClockInterface $clock,
        private readonly EntityActivity $activity,
    ) {}

    #[Override]
    public function allowed(Principal $p, string $entityKey, string $action): bool
    {
        if (! $this->activity->isActive($entityKey)) {
            return false;
        }

        $roleIds = $this->activeRoleIds($p);

        if ($roleIds !== [] && $this->matrixQuery($roleIds, $entityKey, $action)
            ->where('scope', '<>', Scope::None->value)->exists()) {
            return true;
        }

        return $this->directGrants->hasActive($p, "{$this->panel()}.{$entityKey}.{$action}");
    }

    #[Override]
    public function scopeFor(Principal $p, string $entityKey, string $action, ?RecordContext $ctx = null): Scope
    {
        if (! $this->activity->isActive($entityKey)) {
            return Scope::None;
        }

        $roleIds = $this->activeRoleIds($p);

        if ($roleIds === []) {
            return Scope::None;
        }

        $memoKey = $this->memoKey($p, $entityKey, $action, $ctx, $roleIds);

        if (array_key_exists($memoKey, $this->scopeMemo)) {
            return $this->scopeMemo[$memoKey];
        }

        $effective = $this->maxOf(
            $this->matrixQuery($roleIds, $entityKey, $action)->whereNull('context_type')->pluck('scope'),
        );

        if ($ctx instanceof RecordContext) {
            $contextRows = $this->matrixQuery($roleIds, $entityKey, $action)
                ->where('context_type', $ctx->type)
                ->where('context_id', $ctx->id)
                ->pluck('scope');

            if ($contextRows->isNotEmpty()) {
                $effective = $this->maxOf($contextRows);
            }
        }

        if ($this->degradesToNone($p->principalType(), $effective)) {
            $effective = Scope::None;
        }

        return $this->scopeMemo[$memoKey] = $effective;
    }

    #[Override]
    public function canOnRecord(Principal $p, string $action, object $record): bool
    {
        $entity = $this->entities->forModel($record::class);

        if ($entity === null) {
            return false;
        }

        if (! $this->activity->isActive($entity->handle)) {
            return false;
        }

        $key = "{$this->panel()}.{$entity->handle}.{$action}";

        if ($this->directGrants->hasActive($p, $key)) {
            return true;
        }

        return $this->allowed($p, $entity->handle, $action)
            && $this->scopePredicate->matches(
                (new ScopeAvailability($this->entities, $this->connections))->normalize($entity->handle, $this->scopeFor($p, $entity->handle, $action)),
                $record,
                $p,
            );
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    private function activeRoleIds(Principal $p): array
    {
        $workspaceId = $this->tenancyManager->context()?->workspace?->id;

        $connection = $this->connections->connection();
        $now = $this->clock->now();

        return $connection->table('aut_role_assignments')
            ->whereIn('role_id', $connection->table('aut_roles')->select('id')->whereNull('deleted_at'))
            ->where('principal_type', $p->principalType()->value)
            ->where('principal_id', $p->principalId())
            ->where(static function (Builder $q) use ($now): void {
                $q->whereNull('expires_at')->orWhere('expires_at', '>', $now);
            })
            ->where(static function (Builder $q) use ($workspaceId): void {
                $q->whereNull('workspace_id');

                if ($workspaceId !== null) {
                    $q->orWhere('workspace_id', $workspaceId);
                }
            })
            ->pluck('role_id')
            ->unique()
            ->values()
            ->all();
    }

    /** @param list<string> $roleIds */
    private function matrixQuery(array $roleIds, string $entityKey, string $action): Builder
    {
        return $this->connections->connection()->table('aut_role_matrix')
            ->whereIn('role_id', $roleIds)
            ->where('entity_key', $entityKey)
            ->where('action', $action);
    }

    /** @param Collection<int, string> $values */
    private function maxOf(Collection $values): Scope
    {
        $winner = Scope::None;

        foreach ($values as $value) {
            $candidate = Scope::from($value);

            if ($candidate->weight() > $winner->weight()) {
                $winner = $candidate;
            }
        }

        return $winner;
    }

    private function degradesToNone(PrincipalType $type, Scope $scope): bool
    {
        return in_array($type, [PrincipalType::Agent, PrincipalType::ApiKey], true)
            && in_array($scope, [Scope::Own, Scope::Dept, Scope::DeptTree], true);
    }

    /** @param list<string> $roleIds */
    private function memoKey(Principal $p, string $entityKey, string $action, ?RecordContext $ctx, array $roleIds): string
    {
        sort($roleIds);
        $versionFingerprint = array_map(fn (string $roleId): array => [$roleId, $this->scopeMapVersion->current($roleId)], $roleIds);

        return json_encode([
            $this->tenancyManager->context()?->account->id,
            $this->tenancyManager->context()?->workspace?->id,
            $this->panel(),
            $p->principalType()->value,
            $p->principalId(),
            $entityKey,
            $action,
            $ctx->type ?? '',
            $ctx->id ?? '',
            $versionFingerprint,
        ], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
    }

    private function panel(): string
    {
        return $this->options->panel;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Access\Access\Internal;

use CoreX\Access\Contracts\AccessChecker;
use CoreX\Access\Contracts\Principal;
use CoreX\Access\Data\RecordContext;
use CoreX\Access\Laravel\AuthOptions;
use CoreX\Access\Laravel\ScopeResolver;
use CoreX\Access\Matrix\Contracts\EntityActivity;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Override;

/**
 * `apply()`'s phase order is a byte-exact mirror of
 * `DefaultAccessChecker::canOnRecord()` (D110): (1) an active direct grant
 * bypasses the scope predicate entirely; (2) no capability at all ⇒ the
 * whole query denies (`WHERE 1 = 0`); (3) otherwise the compiled scope,
 * normalized against the entity's declared capabilities
 * ({@see ScopeAvailability}, D114), is applied via {@see ScopePredicate} —
 * the single owner of scope semantics shared with the record path.
 *
 * @internal spec: B-11 §3.3/§5.5, P2.9 D110/D114/D116
 */
final readonly class DefaultScopeResolver implements ScopeResolver
{
    public function __construct(
        private AccessChecker $accessChecker,
        private ScopePredicate $predicate,
        private ScopeAvailability $availability,
        private DirectGrantLookup $directGrants,
        private AuthOptions $options,
        private EntityActivity $activity,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  Builder<Model>  $q
     * @return Builder<Model>
     */
    #[Override]
    public function apply(Builder $q, Principal $p, string $entityKey, string $action, ?RecordContext $ctx = null): Builder
    {
        if (! $this->activity->isActive($entityKey)) {
            return $this->deny($q);
        }

        $key = "{$this->panel()}.{$entityKey}.{$action}";

        if ($this->directGrants->hasActive($p, $key)) {
            return $q;
        }

        if (! $this->accessChecker->allowed($p, $entityKey, $action)) {
            return $this->deny($q);
        }

        $scope = $this->availability->normalize($entityKey, $this->accessChecker->scopeFor($p, $entityKey, $action, $ctx));

        return $this->predicate->applyTo($q, $scope, $p);
    }

    private function panel(): string
    {
        return $this->options->panel;
    }

    /** @param Builder<Model> $q
     * @return Builder<Model>
     */
    private function deny(Builder $q): Builder
    {
        $q->getQuery()->whereRaw('1 = 0');

        return $q;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Access\Matrix\Internal;

use Closure;
use CoreX\Access\Laravel\AuthOptions;
use CoreX\Access\Matrix\Contracts\ScopeMapVersions;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\TenantContextResolver;
use Illuminate\Cache\Lock;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Cache\Factory as CacheFactory;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Cache\LockProvider;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Cache\Repository;

/**
 * Versioned cache key for one role's compiled scope-map (B-11 §5.5) — bumped
 * as the LAST step of {@see DatabaseRoleMatrixCompiler::compile()} (§7.3
 * п.8), never before the transaction that published the matrix event
 * commits. Carries an explicit tenant salt (the account id) rather than
 * relying on a cache-store prefix bootstrapper: `axiomasoft/corex-access` runs in boxed installs too,
 * where no such bootstrapper is wired.
 */
final readonly class ScopeMapVersion implements ScopeMapVersions
{
    public function __construct(
        private TenantContextResolver $tenantContext,
        private CacheFactory $cache,
        private AuthOptions $options,
    ) {}

    public function current(string $roleId): int
    {
        return (int) $this->store()->get($this->key($roleId), 0);
    }

    /** Bumps and returns the new version. */
    public function bump(string $roleId): int
    {
        return ($this->invalidator($roleId))();
    }

    /** Capture the tenant key before an outer transaction can switch context. */
    public function invalidator(string $roleId): Closure
    {
        $store = $this->store();
        $key = $this->key($roleId);

        return static function () use ($store, $key): int {
            $increment = static function () use ($store, $key): int {
                $store->add($key, 0);

                return (int) $store->increment($key);
            };
            $backend = $store->getStore();

            // FileStore's increment is a read/put pair, not an atomic counter.
            // The framework polls a blocked lock every 250ms, which is longer than
            // this critical section, so concurrent bumps time out while the lock is free.
            if (! $backend instanceof LockProvider) {
                return $increment();
            }

            $lock = $backend->lock($key.':bump', 10);

            if ($lock instanceof Lock) {
                $lock->betweenBlockedAttemptsSleepFor(50);
            }

            return $lock->block(5, $increment);
        };
    }

    private function key(string $roleId): string
    {
        $accountId = $this->tenantContext->current()->account->id;

        return "corex-access.scope-map.{$accountId}.{$roleId}";
    }

    private function store(): Repository
    {
        return $this->cache->store($this->options->cacheStore);
    }
}

namespace CoreX\AccessAzguard\Internal;

use AzGuard\Configuration\Config as AzGuardConfig;
use AzGuard\Registry\Contracts\GrantSource;
use AzGuard\Registry\Values\PermissionSet;
use CoreX\Access\Contracts\Principal;
use CoreX\Access\Enums\PrincipalType;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\TenancyManager;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Authenticatable;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use Illuminate\Database\Query\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Query\JoinClause;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use Override;
use Psr\Clock\ClockInterface;
use UnexpectedValueException;

/**
 * GrantSource reading `aut_role_assignments` (D101) — the built-in
 * DatabaseRoleGrantSource has no workspace/TTL dimension (findings/P2.8-
 * azguard-inventory-2026-07-26.md §4), so this is a sibling source, not a
 * replacement. Priority 85, the built-in DatabaseRole=90's own docblock
 * slot for a custom source between it and DirectGrant=80.
 *
 * A principal with an active assignment of the system role `owner` gets
 * the wildcard (D103) — the account cannot be in a "nobody can do anything"
 * state before any module populates the matrix. The wildcard is computed
 * here, never stored as '*' in az_guard_role_permissions (the catalog
 * filter/validator would reject it).
 */
final readonly class AutMatrixGrantSource implements GrantSource
{
    public function __construct(
        private TenancyManager $tenancyManager,
        private readonly ConnectionResolverInterface $connections,
        private readonly ClockInterface $clock,
    ) {}

    #[Override]
    public function permissionsFor(Authenticatable $user, string $panelId): PermissionSet
    {
        if ($user instanceof Principal) {
            $principalType = $user->principalType();
            $principalId = $user->principalId();
        } else {
            $identifier = $user->getAuthIdentifier();

            if (! is_string($identifier) && ! is_int($identifier)) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('AzGuard principal identifier must be a string or integer.');
            }

            $principalType = PrincipalType::User;
            $principalId = (string) $identifier;
        }

        $workspaceId = $this->tenancyManager->context()?->workspace?->id;

        if ($this->hasActiveOwnerAssignment($principalType, $principalId, $workspaceId)) {
            return PermissionSet::wildcard();
        }

        $keys = $this->assignmentsQuery($principalType, $principalId, $workspaceId)
            ->join('aut_azguard_role_links as links', 'links.role_id', '=', 'aut_role_assignments.role_id')
            ->join('aut_roles', 'aut_roles.id', '=', 'links.role_id')
            ->join(AzGuardConfig::rolePermissionsTable().' as azgrp', static function (JoinClause $join) use ($panelId): void {
                $join->on('azgrp.role_id', '=', 'links.azguard_role_id')
                    ->where('azgrp.panel_id', '=', $panelId);
            })
            ->whereNull('aut_roles.deleted_at')
            ->pluck('azgrp.permission_key')
            ->all();

        foreach ($keys as $key) {
            if (! is_string($key)) {
                throw new UnexpectedValueException('AzGuard permission key must be a string.');
            }
        }

        return PermissionSet::fromRawKeys(array_values(array_unique($keys)));
    }

    #[Override]
    public function priority(): int
    {
        return 85;
    }

    private function hasActiveOwnerAssignment(PrincipalType $principalType, string $principalId, ?string $workspaceId): bool
    {
        return $this->assignmentsQuery($principalType, $principalId, $workspaceId)
            ->join('aut_roles', 'aut_roles.id', '=', 'aut_role_assignments.role_id')
            ->where('aut_roles.slug', 'owner')
            ->where('aut_roles.is_system', true)
            ->whereNull('aut_roles.deleted_at')
            ->exists();
    }

    private function assignmentsQuery(PrincipalType $principalType, string $principalId, ?string $workspaceId): Builder
    {
        $now = $this->clock->now();

        return $this->connections->connection()->table('aut_role_assignments')
            ->where('aut_role_assignments.principal_type', $principalType->value)
            ->where('aut_role_assignments.principal_id', $principalId)
            ->where(static function (Builder $q) use ($now): void {
                $q->whereNull('aut_role_assignments.expires_at')
                    ->orWhere('aut_role_assignments.expires_at', '>', $now);
            })
            ->where(static function (Builder $q) use ($workspaceId): void {
                $q->whereNull('aut_role_assignments.workspace_id');

                if ($workspaceId !== null) {
                    $q->orWhere('aut_role_assignments.workspace_id', $workspaceId);
                }
            });
    }
}

namespace CoreX\Access\Laravel;

use CoreX\Access\Access\Internal\DefaultAccessChecker;
use CoreX\Access\Access\Internal\DefaultScopeResolver;
use CoreX\Access\Access\Internal\ScopeAvailability;
use CoreX\Access\Contracts\AccessChecker;
use CoreX\Access\Contracts\RoleMatrixCompiler;
use CoreX\Access\Extend\Internal\PermissionsMerger;
use CoreX\Access\Matrix\Internal\DatabaseRoleMatrixCompiler;
use CoreX\Access\Matrix\Laravel\MatrixPortBindings;
use CoreX\Access\Roles\Internal\SystemRoleMutationScope;
use CoreX\Attributes\Spi;
use CoreX\Attributes\SpiKind;
use CoreX\Modules\Contracts\PackageRegistrar;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Config\Repository;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Foundation\Application;
use Override;

#[Spi(kind: SpiKind::Call, since: '1.0')]
final class AccessBindingsRegistrar implements PackageRegistrar
{
    #[Override]
    public function register(Application $app): void
    {
        MatrixPortBindings::register($app);

        $app->singleton(AuthOptions::class, static fn (Application $app): AuthOptions => AuthOptions::fromArray(
            (array) $app->make(Repository::class)->get('corex-access', []),
        ));

        // scoped(), not singleton() — DefaultAccessChecker's scopeFor() memo
        // must not survive across requests on a reused worker (Octane).
        $app->scoped(AccessChecker::class, DefaultAccessChecker::class);

        // scoped() for the same reason: ScopeAvailability's per-(entity_key,
        // scope) memo (P2.9 D114) must not survive a reused Octane worker
        // either, and DefaultScopeResolver is resolved once per listing
        // query — binding it keeps that one ScopeAvailability instance (and
        // its memo) shared across every apply() call within one request.
        $app->scoped(ScopeAvailability::class);
        $app->scoped(SystemRoleMutationScope::class);
        $app->scoped(ScopeResolver::class, DefaultScopeResolver::class);

        // P2.21: PermissionsMerger's lifecycle listener needs this resolved
        // through the interface — nothing bound it before (P2.8/P2.9 always
        // constructed DatabaseRoleMatrixCompiler directly).
        $app->bind(RoleMatrixCompiler::class, DatabaseRoleMatrixCompiler::class);

    }

    #[Override]
    public function boot(Application $app): void
    {
        $app->make(AuthOptions::class);
    }
}

use CoreX\Access\Contracts\Principal;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Authenticatable;

/**
 * Authentication carrier for user, agent and api_key principals. The morph
 * class is the principal type and the auth identifier is its UUID.
 */
#[Spi(kind: SpiKind::Call, since: '1.0')]
final class PrincipalIdentity implements Authenticatable, Principal
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly PrincipalType $type,
        private readonly string $id,
        private readonly ?string $passwordHash = null,
    ) {}

    public static function fromPrincipal(Principal $principal): self
    {
        return new self($principal->principalType(), $principal->principalId());
    }

    #[Override]
    public function principalType(): PrincipalType
    {
        return $this->type;
    }

    #[Override]
    public function principalId(): string
    {
        return $this->id;
    }

    /** A plain principal type, never an Eloquent class name. */
    public function getMorphClass(): string
    {
        return $this->type->value;
    }

    #[Override]
    public function getAuthIdentifierName(): string
    {
        return 'id';
    }

    #[Override]
    public function getAuthIdentifier(): string
    {
        return $this->id;
    }

    #[Override]
    public function getAuthPasswordName(): string
    {
        return 'password';
    }

    /**
     * `null` for the `agent`/`api_key` lanes (no password) and for the OIDC
     * lane (never constructed with a hash — `Auth::loginUsingId()` skips
     * credential validation entirely); the local login lane
     * ({@see CoreX\Access\Identity\Laravel\PrincipalUserProvider}) is the only constructor of a
     * `PrincipalIdentity` that passes one.
     */
    #[Override]
    public function getAuthPassword(): ?string
    {
        return $this->passwordHash;
    }

    #[Override]
    public function getRememberToken(): ?string
    {
        return null;
    }

    #[Override]
    public function setRememberToken(mixed $value): void
    {
        // No remember-me session for a non-interactive principal.
    }

    #[Override]
    public function getRememberTokenName(): string
    {
        return '';
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Access\Matrix\Internal;

use CoreX\Access\Matrix\Contracts\EntityActivity;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\TenantContextResolver;
use CoreX\Modules\Contracts\EntityRegistry;
use CoreX\Modules\Contracts\ModuleRegistry;

/**
 * Single owner of "does this entity_key currently give out a permission
 * key" (AC-27, D112/D113): {@see DatabaseRoleMatrixCompiler} and
 * {@see MatrixPermissionCatalogBuilder} both filter through this one method
 * instead of repeating the two-part condition — unknown entity_key OR
 * inactive owning module — twice.
 *
 * `TenantContextResolver::current()` (not the nullable
 * `TenancyManager::context()`) — the same contract `DomainEvent` itself
 * resolves at construction (B-11 §3.1) — throws `CentralContextException`
 * in the true central/root scope instead of guessing a tenant. Both call
 * sites already assume a tenant-scoped DB connection (`aut_role_matrix` is
 * a tenant table), so a resolvable context is an existing precondition, not
 * a new one; boxed installs (`SingleAccountResolver`) never throw here.
 */
final readonly class ActiveEntityFilter implements EntityActivity
{
    public function __construct(
        private EntityRegistry $entities,
        private ModuleRegistry $modules,
        private TenantContextResolver $tenantContext,
    ) {}

    public function isActive(string $entityKey): bool
    {
        if (! $this->entities->has($entityKey)) {
            return false;
        }

        $module = $this->entities->get($entityKey)->module;

        return $this->modules->isActive($module, $this->tenantContext->current());
    }
}

use CoreX\Access\Access\Laravel\PrincipalIdentity;

use CoreX\Access\Laravel\ScopeResolver;
use CoreX\Access\Roles\Internal\Models\Role;

use CoreX\Access\Tests\Stubs\Deal;
use CoreX\Access\Tests\Stubs\FakeModuleRegistry;
use CoreX\Modules\Contracts\ModuleRegistry;
use CoreX\Modules\Data\EntityDefinition;
use CoreX\Modules\Enums\Capability;

use Illuminate\Support\Str;

uses()->group('pg');

beforeEach(function (): void {
    $this->resetPgSchema();
    $this->migrateAutSchema();
    $this->migrateFixtures();

    app(ArrayEntityRegistry::class)->register(new EntityDefinition(
        handle: 'crm.deal', model: Deal::class, table: 'deals', module: 'corex/access-tests',
        labelSingular: 'Deal', labelPlural: 'Deals',
        capabilities: [Capability::Ownable, Capability::WorkspaceScoped], fields: [], titleAttribute: null,
    ));
    app()->instance(ModuleRegistry::class, new FakeModuleRegistry(['corex/access-tests']));
});

function nativeGrant(PrincipalIdentity $principal, ?string $expiresAt = null, ?string $revokedAt = null, string $entityKey = 'crm.deal'): void
{
    DB::table('aut_direct_grants')->insert([
        'id' => (string) Str::uuid7(),
        'principal_type' => $principal->principalType()->value,
        'principal_id' => $principal->principalId(),
        'permission_key' => "app.{$entityKey}.read",
        'expires_at' => $expiresAt,
        'revoked_at' => $revokedAt,
    ]);
}

it('honours an active native direct grant on capability, record and builder paths without a role', function (): void {
    $principal = new PrincipalIdentity(PrincipalType::User, (string) Str::uuid7());
    $record = Deal::query()->create(['id' => (string) Str::uuid7(), 'owner_id' => (string) Str::uuid7()]);
    nativeGrant($principal);
    $checker = app(AccessChecker::class);

    expect($checker->allowed($principal, 'crm.deal', 'read'))->toBeTrue()
        ->and($checker->scopeFor($principal, 'crm.deal', 'read'))->toBe(Scope::None)
        ->and($checker->canOnRecord($principal, 'read', $record))->toBeTrue()
        ->and(app(ScopeResolver::class)->apply(Deal::query(), $principal, 'crm.deal', 'read')->pluck('id')->all())->toBe([$record->id]);
});

it('denies expired and revoked native direct grants', function (string $expiresAt, string $revokedAt): void {
    $principal = new PrincipalIdentity(PrincipalType::User, (string) Str::uuid7());
    $record = Deal::query()->create(['id' => (string) Str::uuid7(), 'owner_id' => $principal->principalId()]);
    nativeGrant($principal, $expiresAt ?: null, $revokedAt ?: null);
    $checker = app(AccessChecker::class);

    expect($checker->allowed($principal, 'crm.deal', 'read'))->toBeFalse()
        ->and($checker->canOnRecord($principal, 'read', $record))->toBeFalse()
        ->and(app(ScopeResolver::class)->apply(Deal::query(), $principal, 'crm.deal', 'read')->pluck('id')->all())->toBeEmpty();
})->with([
    'expired' => [now()->subMinute()->toDateTimeString(), ''],
    'revoked' => ['', now()->subMinute()->toDateTimeString()],
]);

it('denies all four access paths for an inactive entity even with a matrix row and direct grant', function (bool $registered): void {
    $modules = new FakeModuleRegistry($registered ? [] : ['corex/access-tests']);
    app()->instance(ModuleRegistry::class, $modules);
    $entityKey = $registered ? 'crm.deal' : 'ghost.deal';
    $principal = new PrincipalIdentity(PrincipalType::User, (string) Str::uuid7());
    $role = Role::query()->create([
        'slug' => 'role-'.Str::uuid7(), 'name' => 'Role', 'is_system' => false,
        'assignable_to' => [PrincipalType::User->value],
    ]);
    RoleMatrixRow::query()->create(['role_id' => $role->id, 'entity_key' => $entityKey, 'action' => 'read', 'scope' => 'account']);
    RoleAssignment::query()->create(['role_id' => $role->id, 'principal_type' => 'user', 'principal_id' => $principal->principalId()]);
    $record = Deal::query()->create(['id' => (string) Str::uuid7(), 'owner_id' => $principal->principalId()]);
    nativeGrant($principal, entityKey: $entityKey);
    $checker = app(AccessChecker::class);

    $recordForCheck = $registered ? $record : new class extends Model {};

    expect(DB::table('aut_direct_grants')->where('permission_key', "app.{$entityKey}.read")->exists())->toBeTrue()
        ->and($checker->allowed($principal, $entityKey, 'read'))->toBeFalse()
        ->and($checker->scopeFor($principal, $entityKey, 'read'))->toBe(Scope::None)
        ->and($checker->canOnRecord($principal, 'read', $recordForCheck))->toBeFalse()
        ->and(app(ScopeResolver::class)->apply(Deal::query(), $principal, $entityKey, 'read')->pluck('id')->all())->toBeEmpty();
})->with([
    'registered entity with disabled module' => [true],
    'unknown entity key' => [false],
]);

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\AccessAzguard\Internal;

use AzGuard\Registry\Contracts\PermissionCatalogBuilder;
use AzGuard\Registry\Contracts\PermissionDefinition;
use AzGuard\Registry\Definitions\SimplePermissionDefinition;
use AzGuard\Registry\Resolver\EffectivePermissionResolver;
use CoreX\Access\Enums\Scope;
use CoreX\Access\Laravel\AuthOptions;
use CoreX\Access\Matrix\Contracts\EntityActivity;
use CoreX\Access\Roles\Data\RoleMatrixEntry;
use CoreX\Access\Roles\Laravel\RoleMatrixData;
use Override;

/**
 * Feeds the keys compiled from `aut_role_matrix` into AzGuard's permission
 * catalog (`registerCatalogBuilder()`) — without it, a panel with a
 * registered catalog would have every compiled key filtered out by
 * {@see EffectivePermissionResolver}, and a role
 * with `validate_role_permissions` enabled could never save one
 * (findings/P2.8-azguard-inventory-2026-07-26.md §7).
 */
final readonly class MatrixPermissionCatalogBuilder implements PermissionCatalogBuilder
{
    /**
     * `$activeEntities` defaults to null (resolved from the container
     * Catalog filtering follows the public access entity activity port.
     */
    public function __construct(
        private AuthOptions $options,
        private EntityActivity $activeEntities,
    ) {}

    #[Override]
    public function supports(string $panelId): bool
    {
        return $panelId === $this->options->panel;
    }

    /** @return list<PermissionDefinition> */
    #[Override]
    public function build(string $panelId): array
    {
        if (! $this->supports($panelId)) {
            return [];
        }

        return array_values(collect(RoleMatrixData::matrix())
            ->filter(static fn (RoleMatrixEntry $row): bool => $row->scope !== Scope::None)
            ->filter(fn (RoleMatrixEntry $row): bool => $this->activeEntities->isActive($row->entityKey))
            ->map(static fn (RoleMatrixEntry $row): string => "{$panelId}.{$row->entityKey}.{$row->action}")
            ->unique()
            ->map(static fn (string $key): PermissionDefinition => new SimplePermissionDefinition($key, $panelId))
            ->values()
            ->all());
    }
}

function bridgeRole(): string
{
    $roleId = (string) Str::uuid();
    DB::table('aut_roles')->insert(['id' => $roleId, 'slug' => 'sales', 'name' => 'Sales', 'assignable_to' => '["user"]']);
    foreach ([['crm.deal', 'read', 'account'], ['crm.deal', 'delete', 'none'], ['inactive.deal', 'read', 'account']] as [$entity, $action, $scope]) {
        DB::table('aut_role_matrix')->insert([
            'id' => (string) Str::uuid(), 'role_id' => $roleId,
            'entity_key' => $entity, 'action' => $action, 'scope' => $scope,
        ]);
    }

    return $roleId;
}

it('compiles through the registered bridge on the same tenant transaction and clean role schema', function (): void {
    $roleId = bridgeRole();
    $connection = DB::connection();
    $versions = app(ScopeMapVersions::class);
    $initial = $versions->current($roleId);
    $writes = [];
    $seen = [];

    DB::listen(function (QueryExecuted $query) use (&$writes): void {
        if (preg_match('/^(insert|update|delete).*\b(aut_azguard_role_links|az_guard_roles|az_guard_role_permissions)\b/i', $query->sql) === 1) {
            $writes[] = [$query->connection, $query->connection->transactionLevel()];
        }
    });
    Event::listen(RoleMatrixCompiled::class, function (RoleMatrixCompiled $event) use (&$seen, $versions): void {
        $azguardRoleId = DB::table('aut_azguard_role_links')->where('role_id', $event->roleId)->value('azguard_role_id');
        $seen[] = [
            $event->roleId,
            DB::transactionLevel(),
            RolePermission::query()->where('role_id', $azguardRoleId)->pluck('permission_key')->all(),
            $versions->current($event->roleId),
        ];
    });

    $compiler = app(RoleMatrixCompiler::class);
    expect($compiler)->toBeInstanceOf(DatabaseRoleMatrixCompiler::class);
    $compiler->compile($roleId);

    $azguardRole = AzGuardRoleModel::query()->where('name', 'sales')->firstOrFail();
    expect(Schema::hasColumn('aut_roles', 'azguard_role_id'))->toBeFalse()
        ->and(DB::table('aut_azguard_role_links')->where('role_id', $roleId)->value('azguard_role_id'))->toBe($azguardRole->id)
        ->and(RolePermission::query()->where('role_id', $azguardRole->id)->pluck('permission_key')->all())->toBe(['app.crm.deal.read'])
        ->and($seen)->toBe([[$roleId, 1, ['app.crm.deal.read'], $initial]])
        ->and($versions->current($roleId))->toBe($initial + 1)
        ->and($writes)->not->toBeEmpty();
    foreach ($writes as [$writeConnection, $level]) {
        expect($writeConnection)->toBe($connection)
            ->and($level)->toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    }

    DB::table('aut_role_matrix')->where('role_id', $roleId)->delete();
    $compiler->compile($roleId);
    expect(RolePermission::query()->where('role_id', $azguardRole->id)->count())->toBe(0)
        ->and(DB::table('aut_azguard_role_links')->where('role_id', $roleId)->value('azguard_role_id'))->toBe($azguardRole->id)
        ->and($versions->current($roleId))->toBe($initial + 2);
});

it('propagates a missing role during compilation without invalidating scope', function (): void {
    $roleId = (string) Str::uuid();
    $versions = app(ScopeMapVersions::class);
    $initial = $versions->current($roleId);
    expect(fn () => app(RoleMatrixCompiler::class)->compile($roleId))->toThrow(ModelNotFoundException::class);
    expect($versions->current($roleId))->toBe($initial)
        ->and(DB::table('aut_azguard_role_links')->count())->toBe(0)
        ->and(AzGuardRoleModel::query()->count())->toBe(0);
});

it('rolls back native and bridge writes when the registered bridge listener fails', function (bool $existingMirror): void {
    $roleId = bridgeRole();
    $compiler = app(RoleMatrixCompiler::class);
    $versions = app(ScopeMapVersions::class);

    if ($existingMirror) {
        $compiler->compile($roleId);
    }
    $initial = $versions->current($roleId);
    $links = DB::table('aut_azguard_role_links')->get()->all();
    $roles = DB::table('az_guard_roles')->get()->all();
    $permissions = DB::table('az_guard_role_permissions')->get()->all();
    $matrix = DB::table('aut_role_matrix')->get()->all();
    $seen = [];

    app()->instance(EntityActivity::class, new class($roleId, $seen) implements EntityActivity
    {
        public function __construct(private string $roleId, private array &$seen) {}

        public function isActive(string $entityKey): bool
        {
            $this->seen[] = [DB::transactionLevel(), DB::table('aut_azguard_role_links')->where('role_id', $this->roleId)->exists()];
            DB::table('aut_roles')->where('id', $this->roleId)->update(['name' => 'Uncommitted']);
            DB::table('aut_role_matrix')->where('role_id', $this->roleId)->update(['scope' => 'own']);

            throw new RuntimeException('bridge listener failure');
        }
    });

    expect(fn () => $compiler->compile($roleId))->toThrow(RuntimeException::class, 'bridge listener failure');
    expect($seen)->toBe([[2, true]])
        ->and(DB::transactionLevel())->toBe(0)
        ->and(DB::table('aut_roles')->where('id', $roleId)->value('name'))->toBe('Sales')
        ->and(DB::table('aut_role_matrix')->get()->all())->toEqual($matrix)
        ->and(DB::table('aut_azguard_role_links')->get()->all())->toEqual($links)
        ->and(DB::table('az_guard_roles')->get()->all())->toEqual($roles)
        ->and(DB::table('az_guard_role_permissions')->get()->all())->toEqual($permissions)
        ->and($versions->current($roleId))->toBe($initial);
})->with(['new mirror' => false, 'existing mirror' => true]);

it('defers scope invalidation to outer commit and drops it after rollback', function (): void {
    $roleId = bridgeRole();
    $compiler = app(RoleMatrixCompiler::class);
    $versions = app(ScopeMapVersions::class);
    $initial = $versions->current($roleId);

    DB::beginTransaction();
    DB::table('aut_roles')->where('id', $roleId)->update(['name' => 'Uncommitted']);
    $compiler->compile($roleId);
    expect(DB::table('aut_azguard_role_links')->where('role_id', $roleId)->exists())->toBeTrue()
        ->and(RolePermission::query()->pluck('permission_key')->all())->toBe(['app.crm.deal.read'])
        ->and($versions->current($roleId))->toBe($initial);
    DB::rollBack();
    expect(DB::table('aut_azguard_role_links')->where('role_id', $roleId)->exists())->toBeFalse()
        ->and(AzGuardRoleModel::query()->where('name', 'sales')->exists())->toBeFalse()
        ->and(RolePermission::query()->count())->toBe(0)
        ->and(DB::table('aut_roles')->where('id', $roleId)->value('name'))->toBe('Sales')
        ->and($versions->current($roleId))->toBe($initial);

    DB::beginTransaction();
    $compiler->compile($roleId);
    expect($versions->current($roleId))->toBe($initial);
    $this->tenantContext->accountId = 'other-tenant';
    DB::commit();
    expect($versions->current($roleId))->toBe(0);
    $this->tenantContext->accountId = 'bridge-tenant';
    expect($versions->current($roleId))->toBe($initial + 1)
        ->and(RolePermission::query()->pluck('permission_key')->all())->toBe(['app.crm.deal.read']);
});

it('reads compiled permissions through assignments and role links for each principal type', function (PrincipalType $type): void {
    $roleId = bridgeRole();
    $principal = new PrincipalIdentity($type, (string) Str::uuid());
    DB::table('aut_role_assignments')->insert([
        'id' => (string) Str::uuid(), 'role_id' => $roleId,
        'principal_type' => $type->value, 'principal_id' => $principal->principalId(),
    ]);
    $compiler = app(RoleMatrixCompiler::class);
    $source = app(AutMatrixGrantSource::class);
    expect($source->permissionsFor($principal, 'app')->keys())->toBe([]);

    $compiler->compile($roleId);
    expect($source->permissionsFor($principal, 'app')->keys())->toBe(['app.crm.deal.read'])
        ->and($source->permissionsFor($principal, 'admin')->keys())->toBe([]);

    DB::table('aut_role_matrix')->where('role_id', $roleId)->where('action', 'read')->where('entity_key', 'crm.deal')->update(['scope' => 'none']);
    $compiler->compile($roleId);
    expect($source->permissionsFor($principal, 'app')->keys())->toBe([]);
})->with(PrincipalType::cases());

it('excludes ineligible assignments and roles from the compiled grant chain', function (string $exclusion): void {
    $roleId = bridgeRole();
    $principal = new PrincipalIdentity(PrincipalType::User, (string) Str::uuid());
    $assignmentId = (string) Str::uuid();
    DB::table('aut_role_assignments')->insert([
        'id' => $assignmentId, 'role_id' => $roleId,
        'principal_type' => 'user', 'principal_id' => $principal->principalId(),
    ]);
    app(RoleMatrixCompiler::class)->compile($roleId);
    $source = app(AutMatrixGrantSource::class);
    expect($source->permissionsFor($principal, 'app')->keys())->toBe(['app.crm.deal.read']);

    match ($exclusion) {
        'expired' => DB::table('aut_role_assignments')->where('id', $assignmentId)->update(['expires_at' => '2000-01-01 00:00:00']),
        'foreign workspace' => DB::table('aut_role_assignments')->where('id', $assignmentId)->update(['workspace_id' => (string) Str::uuid()]),
        'different principal' => DB::table('aut_role_assignments')->where('id', $assignmentId)->update(['principal_id' => (string) Str::uuid()]),
        'deleted role' => DB::table('aut_roles')->where('id', $roleId)->update(['deleted_at' => '2000-01-01 00:00:00']),
        'missing link' => DB::table('aut_azguard_role_links')->where('role_id', $roleId)->delete(),
    };

    expect($source->permissionsFor($principal, 'app')->keys())->toBe([]);
})->with(['expired', 'foreign workspace', 'different principal', 'deleted role', 'missing link']);

content.text:
dependencies, manifest, CI, changelog BC, and golden files.

AccessIntegrationRegistrar

namespaces. Blade directives rely on hasScopedRole, which may be absent from PrincipalIdentity unless provided by a trait in AzGuard.

Blade directives must

during boot is standard Laravel and safe. Passing a class string to `registerGrantSource` may not match AzGuard's expected interface, since tests instantiate the grant source directly rather than through the manager.

AzGuardBridgeTest

instantiates the grant source directly rather than through the manager. BridgeConfigurationTest may cover registration behavior. The AzGuard package type in composer.json needs verification: D96 specifies `bridge`, but the specification example uses `integration` and glossary semantics. Config pins for AzGuard must be checked against the specification.

The repositories package `azguard` was copied as-is. I will check the root composer `require-dev` and test dependencies, CI steps, ownership map prefixes, table ownership, glossary entries, and schema version 1. The golden file must contain only P07.4 lines. I cannot run git commands to verify manifest and changelog in one product commit, so I will rely on the candidate commit text.

Shell and git commands are unavailable. The review will rely on the files present on disk, using candidate-commit.txt to confirm the working tree matches the bound SHA.

NativePermissionTest omits required coverage for matrix permissions, scope none, and foreign workspace checks. AccessCheckerTest may cover these cases instead. This is a specification compliance gap rather than a concrete product failure.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\AccessAzguard\Internal\Laravel;

use AzGuard\Contracts\ContextGuard;
use AzGuard\Contracts\PermissionLayer;
use CoreX\AccessAzguard\Internal\AccessAzguardOptions;
use CoreX\AccessAzguard\Internal\TenantContextGuard;
use CoreX\AccessAzguard\Internal\WorkspacePermissionLayer;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Config\Repository;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Foundation\Application;

/** @internal Bridge configuration composition. */
final class AccessAzguardBindingsRegistrar
{
    public function register(Application $app): void
    {
        $app->singleton(AccessAzguardOptions::class, static fn (Application $app): AccessAzguardOptions => AccessAzguardOptions::fromArray(
            (array) $app->make(Repository::class)->get('corex-access-azguard', []),
        ));

        // Apply registration-time pins without resolving the shared snapshot before boot.
        $config = $app->make(Repository::class);
        $options = AccessAzguardOptions::fromArray((array) $config->get('corex-access-azguard', []));
        $config->set('az-guard.table_names.roles', $options->rolesTable);
        $config->set('az-guard.column_names.morph_type', $options->morphType);
        $config->set('az-guard.models.role', $options->roleModel);

        $app->singleton(ContextGuard::class, TenantContextGuard::class);

        if ($options->bindPermissionLayer) {
            $app->bind(PermissionLayer::class, WorkspacePermissionLayer::class);
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Access\Laravel;

use CoreX\Attributes\Spi;
use CoreX\Attributes\SpiKind;
use CoreX\Config\Laravel\ConfigurationValidator;

#[Spi(kind: SpiKind::Call, since: '1.0')]
final readonly class AuthOptions
{
    /**
     * @param  array<string, string>  $identityColumns
     */
    public function __construct(
        public string $panel,
        public ?string $cacheStore,
        public ?string $workspaceScopeClass,
        public bool $identityEnabled,
        public ?string $identityConnection,
        public string $identityTable,
        public array $identityColumns,
    ) {}

    /** @param  array<array-key, mixed>  $config */
    public static function fromArray(array $config): self
    {
        $violations = new ConfigurationValidator;

        $panel = self::nonEmpty($violations, 'panel', $config['panel'] ?? 'app');

        $cache = is_array($config['cache'] ?? null) ? $config['cache'] : [];
        $cacheStore = self::nullableString($cache['store'] ?? null);

        $workspaceScopeClass = self::nullableString($config['workspace_scope_class'] ?? null);

        if ($workspaceScopeClass === '') {
            $workspaceScopeClass = null;
        }

        $identity = is_array($config['identity'] ?? null) ? $config['identity'] : [];
        $identityEnabled = self::bool($violations, 'identity.enabled', $identity['enabled'] ?? true);
        $identityConnection = self::nullableString($identity['connection'] ?? null);
        $identityTable = self::nonEmpty($violations, 'identity.table', $identity['table'] ?? 'users');

        $defaults = [
            'id' => 'id',
            'email' => 'email',
            'password' => 'password_hash',
            'active' => 'is_active',
            'deleted_at' => 'deleted_at',
        ];
        $rawColumns = is_array($identity['columns'] ?? null) ? $identity['columns'] : null;
        $identityColumns = [];

        if ($rawColumns === null) {
            $identityColumns = $defaults;
        } else {
            foreach ($defaults as $key => $default) {
                if (! array_key_exists($key, $rawColumns)) {
                    $violations->add('identity.columns.'.$key, 'must be a non-empty string');
                    $identityColumns[$key] = $default;

                    continue;
                }

                $value = $rawColumns[$key];

                if (is_string($value) && $value !== '') {
                    $identityColumns[$key] = $value;

                    continue;
                }

                $violations->add('identity.columns.'.$key, 'must be a non-empty string');
                $identityColumns[$key] = $default;
            }
        }

        $violations->failIfAny();

        return new self(
            panel: $panel,
            cacheStore: $cacheStore,
            workspaceScopeClass: $workspaceScopeClass,
            identityEnabled: $identityEnabled,
            identityConnection: $identityConnection,
            identityTable: $identityTable,
            identityColumns: $identityColumns,
        );
    }

    private static function bool(ConfigurationValidator $violations, string $path, mixed $value): bool
    {
        if (is_bool($value)) {
            return $value;
        }

        $violations->add($path, 'must be a boolean');

        return false;
    }

    private static function nonEmpty(ConfigurationValidator $violations, string $path, mixed $value): string
    {
        if (is_string($value) && $value !== '') {
            return $value;
        }

        $violations->add($path, 'must be a non-empty string');

        return 'invalid';
    }

    private static function nullableString(mixed $value): ?string
    {
        if ($value === null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (is_string($value)) {
            return $value;
        }

        return null;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\AccessAzguard\Internal;

use AzGuard\Models\Role;
use CoreX\Config\Laravel\ConfigurationValidator;

/** @internal Immutable configuration for bridge composition. */
final readonly class AccessAzguardOptions
{
    /** @param class-string<Role>|null $roleModel */
    public function __construct(
        public bool $bindPermissionLayer,
        public string $rolesTable,
        public string $morphType,
        public ?string $roleModel,
    ) {}

    /** @param array<array-key, mixed> $config */
    public static function fromArray(array $config): self
    {
        $violations = new ConfigurationValidator;
        $bindPermissionLayer = $config['bind_permission_layer'] ?? true;

        if (! is_bool($bindPermissionLayer)) {
            $violations->add('bind_permission_layer', 'must be a boolean');
            $bindPermissionLayer = false;
        }

        $pins = self::section($violations, 'azguard_pins', $config['azguard_pins'] ?? []);
        $tables = self::section($violations, 'azguard_pins.table_names', $pins['table_names'] ?? []);
        $columns = self::section($violations, 'azguard_pins.column_names', $pins['column_names'] ?? []);
        $models = self::section($violations, 'azguard_pins.models', $pins['models'] ?? []);
        $rolesTable = $tables['roles'] ?? 'az_guard_roles';

        if (! is_string($rolesTable) || trim($rolesTable) === '') {
            $violations->add('azguard_pins.table_names.roles', 'must be a non-empty string');
            $rolesTable = 'az_guard_roles';
        }

        $morphType = $columns['morph_type'] ?? 'uuid';

        if (! in_array($morphType, ['int', 'ulid', 'uuid'], true)) {
            $violations->add('azguard_pins.column_names.morph_type', 'must be int, ulid or uuid');
            $morphType = 'uuid';
        }

        $roleModel = array_key_exists('role', $models) ? $models['role'] : AzGuardRoleModel::class;

        if ($roleModel !== null && (! is_string($roleModel) || ! is_a($roleModel, Role::class, true))) {
            $violations->add('azguard_pins.models.role', 'must be an AzGuard role class or null');
            $roleModel = AzGuardRoleModel::class;
        }

        $violations->failIfAny();

        return new self(
            bindPermissionLayer: $bindPermissionLayer,
            rolesTable: $rolesTable,
            morphType: $morphType,
            roleModel: $roleModel,
        );
    }

    /** @return array<array-key, mixed> */
    private static function section(ConfigurationValidator $violations, string $path, mixed $value): array
    {
        if (is_array($value)) {
            return $value;
        }

        $violations->add($path, 'must be an array');

        return [];
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\AccessAzguard\Internal;

use AzGuard\Contracts\ContextGuard;
use CoreX\Modules\Contracts\EntityRegistry;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Authenticatable;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Override;

/**
 * Implements AzGuard's ContextGuard seam (the binding AzGuard expects from an
 * external package) so `$user->hasPermissionIn($type, $id, $permission)` works:
 * the context entity is resolved through axiomasoft/corex's EntityRegistry (single
 * morph source, ADR-003), and the check passes when the user has the
 * permission scoped to that entity, or globally within the panel.
 *
 * Tenant isolation of the resolved entity is physical (DB-per-account, B-11):
 * an entity loaded here already came from its account's database.
 */
final class TenantContextGuard implements ContextGuard
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EntityRegistry $entities,
    ) {}

    #[Override]
    public function checkInContext(
        Authenticatable $user,
        string $contextType,
        int|string $contextId,
        string $permission,
        string $panelId,
    ): bool {
        $entity = $this->resolveContext($contextType, $contextId);

        if (! $entity instanceof Model) {
            return false;
        }

        $scopedCheck = [$user, 'hasScopedPermission'];

        if (is_callable($scopedCheck) && $scopedCheck($permission, $entity) === true) {
            return true;
        }

        $globalCheck = [$user, 'hasPermission'];

        return is_callable($globalCheck) && $globalCheck($permission, $panelId) === true;
    }

    private function resolveContext(string $contextType, int|string $contextId): ?Model
    {
        if (! $this->entities->has($contextType)) {
            return null;
        }

        $class = $this->entities->get($contextType)->model;
        $instance = new $class;

        if (! $instance instanceof Model) {
            return null;
        }

        return $instance->newQuery()->whereKey($contextId)->first();
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\AccessAzguard\Internal;

use AzGuard\Contracts\PermissionLayer;
use AzGuard\Registry\Values\PermissionSet;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\TenancyManager;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Authenticatable;
use Override;

/**
 * Cache-discriminator layer (D101) — apply() is the identity function
 * (AutMatrixGrantSource already scoped its keys to the active workspace at
 * the source, so this layer never narrows); its role is purely to tag the
 * resolver's per-request cache entry so workspace 42 and workspace 99 never
 * share one (findings/P2.8-azguard-inventory-2026-07-26.md §6) — without
 * it, a resolved set for one workspace would leak into the next request-
 * local lookup for another.
 */
final readonly class WorkspacePermissionLayer implements PermissionLayer
{
    public function __construct(
        private TenancyManager $tenancyManager,
    ) {}

    #[Override]
    public function apply(PermissionSet $global, Authenticatable $user, string $panelId): PermissionSet
    {
        return $global;
    }

    #[Override]
    public function cacheDiscriminator(string $panelId): string
    {
        return $this->tenancyManager->context()?->workspace->id ?? '';
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Context\Data;

use CoreX\Attributes\Api;

/**
 * The current account/workspace pair a request or job runs under. Resolved
 * by axiomasoft/corex-tenancy; boxed installs get a constant singleton via
 * {@see SingleAccountResolver}.
 *
 * Contract: B-10 §3.1, B-11 §3.1 (owner: B-11).
 */
#[Api(since: '1.0')]
final readonly class TenantContext
{
    public function __construct(
        public AccountRef $account,
        public ?WorkspaceRef $workspace = null,
        private bool $boxed = false,
    ) {}

    /**
     * True iff this context was produced by {@see SingleAccountResolver}
     * (boxed installs), not by a real P2 tenancy resolver.
     */
    public function isBoxed(): bool
    {
        return $this->boxed;
    }

    public function forWorkspace(WorkspaceRef $workspace): self
    {
        return new self($this->account, $workspace, $this->boxed);
    }
}
